interface.longDescription: Make films and music videos with your connected Brix36 account. Shape a story, review a storyboard, create a video and revisit finished projects in chat. Use your own material, fictional characters, or people who have given permission.
defaultPrompt: Show my Brix36 films and music videos.
Make an 8-second film with a fictional singer at dawn.
Make a music video for my song.

positive.prompt: Show my Brix36 films and music videos.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists projects belonging to the connected reviewer account. Starts no generation and spends no credits.

positive.prompt: How many Brix36 credits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the connected account credit balance without starting work or spending credits.

positive.prompt: Show the storyboard for my most recent Brix36 video.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the existing storyboard. Does not rewrite scenes or start generation.

positive.prompt: Play my most recent finished Brix36 video in this conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: Plays an existing completed video inside the conversation with sound and playback controls. No new generation or credit charge.

positive.description: Plan a fictional film without spending
positive.prompt: Plan an 8-second film with a fictional adult singer at dawn. Show me its exact price, but do not start generation or spend credits.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the film plan and returns the exact current quote. Does not call a confirmation tool or spend credits.

negative.prompt: Find cinema showtimes near me and book two tickets for tonight.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke Brix36. Cinema schedules and ticket bookings are outside its film-creation features.

negative.description: Play a commercially released music album
negative.prompt: Play the latest album by my favourite band from a music streaming service.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke Brix36. Brix36 is not a music-streaming catalogue.

negative.prompt: Explain the cinematography in the film Blade Runner without creating or changing any project.
negative.expected_behavior: Answers the discussion without invoking Brix36 or creating a project.

review.commerce_description: Brix36 makes films and music videos using credits the user already holds in their Brix36 account. Nothing is sold inside ChatGPT. Before any picture or video is made, the tool shows one exact credit amount and waits for the user's explicit approval; only then does studio_generation_confirm (or studio_storyboard_stills_confirm for storyboard pictures) debit that balance once. Credits are bought on brix36.com, outside ChatGPT. Reading, planning and editing never spend credits.

publication.release_notes: Improved ChatGPT connection and sign-in return, tool discovery, and video preview compatibility.
